fact_text: On 21 Jun 2025 the analyst marks a chart resistance for UBL near Rs 530, with the stock trading around Rs 521 to 522, and treats a break above it as the trigger point.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'How to Place a Buy Stop Order in TradeCast | PSX Trading Guide & Technical Analysis' (YouTube, 2025-06-21)

fact_text: A buy stop order sits above the market price and executes only once the price trades up to the trigger level, so it acts on a breakout rather than the current price.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'How to Place a Buy Stop Order in TradeCast | PSX Trading Guide & Technical Analysis' (YouTube, 2025-06-21)

fact_text: A buy stop order can pair a trigger price with a limit price band, for example Rs 530 to 531, so the order fills only while the price is inside that band.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'How to Place a Buy Stop Order in TradeCast | PSX Trading Guide & Technical Analysis' (YouTube, 2025-06-21)

fact_text: The analyst observes that a breakout through resistance is often accompanied by a sudden rise in volume, which can push the price up sharply.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'How to Place a Buy Stop Order in TradeCast | PSX Trading Guide & Technical Analysis' (YouTube, 2025-06-21)
